explication: AI-DLC is a harness-neutral, audited AI software-delivery lifecycle. A developer invokes a configured assistant, whose harness adapter dispatches the core command and orchestrator. The orchestrator resolves a profile and stage graph, advances persistent workflow state, pauses at approval gates, and coordinates implementation, review, sensors, and completion evidence. Audit records, knowledge, and learned rules preserve context across sessions. The tree confirms the core engine, several harness integrations, governance hooks, and optional plugins; some internal dispatch relationships remain inferred from documented capabilities rather than sampled implementations.
